items.title: Google to verify all Android devs to block malware on Google Play
items.description: Google is introducing a new defense for Android called 'Developer Verification' to block malware installations from sideloaded apps sourced from outside the official Google Play app store. [...]

items.title: Citrix fixes critical NetScaler RCE flaw exploited in zero-day attacks
items.description: Citrix fixed three NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway flaws today, including a critical remote code execution flaw tracked as CVE-2025-7775 that was actively exploited in attacks as a zero-day vulnerability. [...]

items.title: Silk Typhoon hackers hijack network captive portals in diplomat attacks
items.description: State-sponsored hackers linked to the Mustang Panda activity cluster targeted diplomats by hijacking web traffic to redirect to a malware serving website. [...]

items.title: 1M Farmers Insurance Customers' Data Compromised
items.description: Though the company is informing its customers of the breach, Farmers isn't publicly divulging what kinds of personal data were affected.

items.title: Citrix Gear Under Active Attack Again With Another Zero-Day
items.description: The flaw is one of three that the company disclosed affecting its NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway technologies.
